category: SEC Football — It Just Means More
prompt: Explain to a Big Ten fan why SEC football just means more. Do not concede a single point.
response: Count the draft picks every April, buddy — the league's half SEC. Count the boys on every NFL defense. Down here the walk-ons would start most places up north, the tailgate's got a generator and a smoker and your mama's casserole, and the loser of the Iron Bowl don't sleep right till next November. It ain't a conference, it's a way of keepin' time. Big Ten plays football; we live it. Not conceding a damn thing.
